After discussing the benefits of different types of hay, the next logical step is to observe how dry weather affects hay cutting decisions (subtask 2).
Observing the effect of dry weather on hay cutting decisions (subtask 2) leads to the importance of limiting hay cutting during hot, dry periods (subtask 3).
The importance of limiting hay cutting during hot, dry periods (subtask 3) is followed by a discussion on the recommended moisture content for stored hay (subtask 4).
After discussing the recommended moisture content, the final subtask highlights the importance of controlling moisture during baling (subtask 5).
